prompt:
Scene:
A square stylized vintage travel-poster illustration of an atomic-age space-flight hostess at the boarding ramp. Front three-quarter portrait composition on a bright pastel gradient background. Slight halftone print grain, matte coated-paper feel.

Subject:
A cheerful hostess in a tailored cadmium-red uniform with chrome-piped shoulders and a small pillbox cap accented with a tiny silver rocket pin. She carries a clipboard and gives a welcoming open-palm gesture. A clear fishbowl bubble helmet clipped to her belt on a chrome clip. Behind her, stylized in soft flat shapes, a silver finned rocket tail and a glass-dome terminal spire evoke the spaceport setting without taking focus. Backdrop is a powder-blue-to-ivory gradient with small stylized starbursts.

Important details:
Strict atomic-age palette: ivory, turquoise, cadmium red, bright yellow, powder pink, chrome, powder blue. Figure rendered in stylized mid-century travel-poster style (flat color shapes, hand-drawn outlines, limited shading). Friendly magazine-ad smile, rouged cheeks, no photoreal skin. Keep halftone grain and slight print offset.

Use case:
Spaceport Vignettes single study 1 of 5, standalone travel-poster style illustration.

Constraints:
No readable text, no watermark, no logos, no photoreal skin, no modern flight attendant uniform, no corporate airline branding, preserve exact 1:1 aspect ratio.
